# Effects

<!-- Generated by `rake docs` from the primitive registry. Do not edit. -->

## add_counters

Put `amount` counters named `counter` on each referenced permanent. Any counter name works (+1/+1, -1/-1, loyalty, stun, shield, oil, a keyword, ...); see docs/reference/counters.md for the ones with rules.

Rules: CR 122.1, CR 122.6, CR 613.4c

| Parameter | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `counter` | counter name (+X/+Y, -X/-Y or a lowercase word) |
| `amount` | integer |
| `to` | selector |

```json
{
  "add_counters": {
    "counter": "+1/+1",
    "amount": 1,
    "to": {
      "each": "creature",
      "controller": "you"
    }
  }
}
```

## add_mana

You add mana to your mana pool: the fixed mana in `produce`, or `amount` mana of a color you choose as it resolves (`color: "any_one"`: all of one color; `color: "any"`: each mana's color chosen separately, "in any combination of colors"). `colors` limits the choice ("add {R} or {G}").

Rules: CR 106.1a, CR 106.4, CR 608.2d, CR 605.1a

| Parameter | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `produce` | mana symbols, e.g. "{R}{R}" |
| `amount` | amount (with color; default 1) |
| `color` | any_one | any |
| `colors` | list of colors to choose from (default all five) |

```json
{
  "add_mana": {
    "amount": 2,
    "color": "any_one"
  }
}
```

## assimilate

Assimilate each referenced permanent or permanent card: you gain control of it (or put it onto the battlefield under your control) with a +1/+1 counter, and it becomes a Borg artifact creature while it stays on the battlefield.

Rules: CR 701.72a, CR 701.72b, CR 205.1b, CR 613.1b, CR 613.1d

| Parameter | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `to` | selector (permanents, or a target card in a graveyard) |

```json
{
  "assimilate": {
    "to": {
      "target": 0
    }
  }
}
```

## attach

Attach this Aura or Equipment (the ability's source) to the referenced permanent. Nothing happens if it can't legally be attached to it, if it's already attached to it, or if the source has left the battlefield.

Rules: CR 701.3a, CR 701.3b, CR 701.3c, CR 301.5c

| Parameter | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `to` | selector (a single target) |

```json
{
  "attach": {
    "to": {
      "target": 0
    }
  }
}
```

## cast_free

The controller may cast referenced cards without paying their mana costs while this resolves. `to` names the cards ({"result": n}), or a player for the cards in their hand (default: your hand). Only cards matching `for`/`not_types` with mana value up to `max_mana_value` (optional amount) that could be cast now (legal targets). `count`: 1 (default) or "any" (any number, one at a time). X is 0 (CR 107.3b).

Rules: CR 608.2g, CR 118.9, CR 601.2a, CR 107.3b, CR 118.6a

| Parameter | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `to` | selector |
| `for` | card spec |
| `not_types` | list of card types |
| `max_mana_value` | amount |
| `count` | 1 or "any" |

```json
{
  "cast_free": {
    "to": {
      "result": 0
    },
    "max_mana_value": 3,
    "count": "any"
  }
}
```

## counter

Counter each referenced spell or ability: a spell leaves the stack for its owner's graveyard without resolving, an ability ceases to exist. A spell that can't be countered stays.

Rules: CR 701.6a, CR 701.6b, CR 101.2

| Parameter | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `to` | selector |

```json
{
  "counter": {
    "to": {
      "target": 0
    }
  }
}
```

## counter_unless_pays

Counter each referenced spell or ability unless its controller pays `mana` as this resolves (they choose, and pay like any cost; mana abilities allowed).

Rules: CR 701.6a, CR 118.12a, CR 605.3a

| Parameter | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `mana` | mana cost string |
| `to` | selector (usually {"target": 0}) |

```json
{
  "counter_unless_pays": {
    "mana": "{3}",
    "to": {
      "target": 0
    }
  }
}
```

## create_token

Create `amount` tokens under the referenced player's control (default: you). `token` is a predefined token name (Treasure, Clue, Food) or an inline card definition. `tapped: true` creates them tapped.

Rules: CR 111.1, CR 111.10, CR 701.7a, CR 704.5d

| Parameter | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `token` | "Treasure" | "Clue" | "Food" | {card data} |
| `amount` | integer (default 1) |
| `tapped` | boolean |
| `to` | selector (default "you") |

```json
{
  "create_token": {
    "token": {
      "name": "Soldier",
      "types": [
        "creature"
      ],
      "subtypes": [
        "soldier"
      ],
      "power": 1,
      "toughness": 1
    }
  }
}
```

## deal_damage

Deal `amount` damage to each referenced creature, planeswalker or player. Damage to a player causes life loss; to a planeswalker removes loyalty counters; to a creature is marked until cleanup.

Rules: CR 120.3a, CR 120.3c, CR 120.3e, CR 120.6

| Parameter | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `amount` | integer |
| `to` | selector |

```json
{
  "deal_damage": {
    "amount": 3,
    "to": {
      "target": 0
    }
  }
}
```

## delayed_trigger

Creates a delayed triggered ability with the controller and source of the resolving spell or ability. It triggers only once, the next time `when` happens (e.g. {"step_begins": {"step": "end", "whose": "each"}} for the next end step). Its `effects` may use {"result": n} for what earlier effects of the creating list moved or created; those objects are affected only if they are still where they were put.

Rules: CR 603.7a, CR 603.7b, CR 603.7c, CR 603.7d, CR 603.7e

| Parameter | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `when` | a trigger condition |
| `effects` | list of effects |

```json
{
  "delayed_trigger": {
    "when": {
      "step_begins": {
        "step": "end",
        "whose": "each"
      }
    },
    "effects": [
      {
        "sacrifice": {
          "to": {
            "result": 0
          }
        }
      }
    ]
  }
}
```

## discover

Discover `amount`: exile cards from the top of your library until you exile a nonland card with mana value `amount` or less. You may cast it without paying its mana cost; if you don't, it goes into your hand. The other exiled cards go on the bottom of your library in a random order.

Rules: CR 701.57a, CR 701.57b, CR 701.57c, CR 608.2g, CR 118.9

| Parameter | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `amount` | amount |

```json
{
  "discover": {
    "amount": 5
  }
}
```

## may

An optional effect. The controller chooses yes or no as it resolves; yes is offered only if every effect in `effects` can be done fully. On yes, `effects` then `then` ("if you do") happen; on no, `otherwise` ("if you don't"). Nested effects may name the results of earlier effects of the enclosing list.

Rules: CR 118.12, CR 118.3, CR 608.2d

| Parameter | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `effects` | list of effects (the optional part) |
| `then` | list of effects |
| `otherwise` | list of effects |

```json
{
  "may": {
    "effects": [
      {
        "discard": {
          "amount": 1
        }
      }
    ],
    "then": [
      {
        "draw": {
          "amount": 1
        }
      }
    ]
  }
}
```

## pay

You may pay `mana` or `life` as it resolves. If you do, `then` happens; if you don't, `otherwise`. Paying mana works like paying a spell's cost (mana abilities may be activated); life can be paid only if you have that much (CR 119.4). For another player paying, see `counter_unless_pays`.

Rules: CR 118.12, CR 118.12a, CR 118.3, CR 119.4, CR 605.3a

| Parameter | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `mana` | mana cost string, e.g. "{1}" |
| `life` | integer |
| `then` | list of effects |
| `otherwise` | list of effects |

```json
{
  "pay": {
    "mana": "{1}",
    "then": [
      {
        "draw": {
          "amount": 1
        }
      }
    ]
  }
}
```

## play_permission

The controller may play (`play: "play"`, default) or cast (`"cast"`) each referenced exiled card matching `for`/`not_types`, paying its costs and following timing rules, for `duration`: end_of_turn (default), end_of_your_next_turn or while_exiled. With `choose: "one_per_owner"` only one chosen card per owner.

Rules: CR 611.2a, CR 601.3, CR 305.1, CR 400.7, CR 514.2

| Parameter | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `to` | selector (usually {"result": n}) |
| `duration` | end_of_turn | end_of_your_next_turn | while_exiled |
| `play` | play | cast |
| `for` | card spec |
| `not_types` | list of card types |
| `choose` | one_per_owner |

```json
{
  "play_permission": {
    "to": {
      "result": 0
    },
    "duration": "end_of_your_next_turn"
  }
}
```

## return_to_battlefield

Put each referenced card that is in exile or a graveyard onto the battlefield under its owner's control (`under: "you"`: under the controller's), tapped if `tapped: true`. A card that is no longer in the zone it was expected in, or isn't a permanent card, stays where it is.

Rules: CR 400.7, CR 400.4a, CR 110.2, CR 111.8, CR 603.7c

| Parameter | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `to` | selector (usually {"result": n}) |
| `tapped` | boolean |
| `under` | owner | you |

```json
{
  "return_to_battlefield": {
    "to": {
      "result": 0
    }
  }
}
```

## search_library

Search your library for up to `count` cards matching `for`, then put them into your hand (or onto the battlefield, tapped if `tapped`) and shuffle. With a stated quality you may find fewer (or none); a search for just "a card" must find one if it can. `reveal` shows the found cards to every player.

Rules: CR 701.23a, CR 701.23b, CR 701.23d, CR 701.23e, CR 701.20a, CR 701.24a, CR 701.24b

| Parameter | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `for` | card spec: "card" (default), {"types"|"subtypes"|"supertypes": [...], "name": "..."} or {"any_of": [spec, ...]} |
| `count` | integer (default 1) or "any" (any number) |
| `put` | "hand" (default) or "battlefield" |
| `tapped` | true: the cards enter tapped (with put: battlefield) |
| `reveal` | true: reveal the found cards |

```json
{
  "search_library": {
    "for": {
      "supertypes": [
        "basic"
      ],
      "types": [
        "land"
      ]
    },
    "reveal": true
  }
}
```
